claims.text:
classifier-free-guidance

**Identity / target / source:** `ai:classifier-free-guidance` → `ai-classifier-free-guidance` → `src/demos/ai/ai-classifier-free-guidance`; source `company/domains/proposals/2026-10-18-ai-map-expansion.json#concepts/82`; brief `company/domains/briefs/2026-10-19-ai-next30e.md#5-classifier-free-guidance`. **Packet:** G2. **Level / prerequisites:** core; `ai:diffusion-denoising`.

**Nearest / distinct payoff:** diffusion-denoising reverses a noisy process; this explicitly combines conditional/unconditional scores and derives its changed normalized distribution.

**Computed primary model:** Unconditional Gaussian score s_u(x)=−x (mean0,variance1); conditional score s_c(x)=2(1−x) (mean1,variance.5). Guided score s_w=s_u+w(s_c−s_u)=2w−(1+w)x. Forw≥0 it corresponds to Gaussian mean2w/(1+w), variance1/(1+w). w0→(0,1),w1→(1,.5),w3→(1.5,.25). Strongerw narrows this distribution but overshoots the conditional mean1.

**Countercase / boundary:** Increasing guidance from1 to3 reduces variance yet worsens mean-distance to conditional target0→.5. These fixed analytic scores are not learned text/image scores, and variance narrowing is not a universal property of guidance. No empirical quality/diversity slogan is admitted.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict whether w3 retains conditional mean1; recallw.5 gives mean2/3 and variance2/3 under this declared score pair.

**Intervention / retained witness:** Change strength recomputes both source-score arrows, combined score, mean/variance and one Euler illustration x=.2,delta=.1: newx .18/.36/.72 atw0/1/3. Retain w1 target alignment and w3 overshoot separately; use labelled variance, no unsupported coverage interval.

**Source obligation:** [Ho–Salimans original CFG PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2207.12598), opened2026-10-19, combined conditional/unconditional score method. Exact Gaussian stationary parameters and Euler illustration here are local calculations, not trained image-model performance; confirm convention s_u+w(s_c−s_u), since papers/libraries may offset w.
